name: The Tentacle Twist
notes: FR-18 phase three (the twist): the players are celebrating and looting the ogre's meager possessions when a tentacle rips through the ogre's stomach and a tentacle creature emerges — the true boss of the level. The ogre was a fake-out. Play this right after examples/mice-ogre.json: the ogre token 'Ogre' must still be on the scene (the mice-ogre script leaves it at (800,1200), which is the `at` below — omit `at` to resolve the corpse token's live position instead). The reveal image must be generated by Muse first (prompt via buildRevealPrompt in src/session/reveal.ts) and uploaded to worlds/testbed/tentacle-emergence.png. The Tentacle Creature actor must exist in the world. Validate with `bun run cutscene --file examples/tentacle-twist.json --validate-only` — no connection needed.

steps.content: The ogre is down. Its possessions are meager — a few copper, a cracked horn — but the looting is just getting started when something moves inside the corpse.
Something is moving under the ogre's skin.

steps.caption: A tentacle rips through the ogre's stomach.

steps.content: The tentacle creature unfolds from the ogre's corpse — this was the true boss of the level all along. Roll initiative.
